title: COSMI: COmpositional Synthesis of Multi-object Interactions
title_zh: COSMI：多物体交互的组合合成

paragraphs.en: Generative models of human-object interaction are bounded by the data that exists: everyday activities involve several objects, but most captured datasets record one at a time, as multi-object capture is combinatorially expensive. Our observation is that interactions are local, so single-object captures already contain the parts of multi-object activities. We compose them: contact-consistent clips of single interactions, mirrored to balance the hands, transfer between bodies, and a language model and geometric checks admit only the pairings that are plausible, semantically and physically. Therefore, the dataset grows combinatorially with the clips rather than recording time. The COSMI dataset holds 222k sequences and 275 hours with up to five objects, nearly thirty times the largest multi-object capture, and can be extended by adding datasets or even hand-object recordings. On this data we train the COSMI method, a text-to-interaction diffusion transformer that follows how the data is built: weight-shared object slots generate a variable number of objects, predicted relative to the body parts that move them. On a benchmark with an unseen object and unseen interaction combinations, models trained on the dataset generalize to the unseen combinations. COSMI outperforms baselines in text alignment and contact accuracy, where its margin is largest on the unseen object. Code, models, and the dataset pipeline will be released.

paragraphs.en: Generating 3D human-object interaction (HOI) serves animation, embodied AI, and augmented reality, from humanoid controllers and robot policies that learn from HOI motion ( Xu et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2025b ) to egocentric assistants ( Banerjee et al., 2025 ; Ma et al., 2024 ; Petrov et al., 2026 ) and composite animation such as sitting down while carrying an object ( Pan et al., 2025 ) . The activities these applications target are frequently multi-object: in the KIT whole-body database, 99 of the 262 object-related motions involve two or more objects ( Mandery et al., 2016 ) . Like other generative models, motion generators improve with data ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Xu et al., 2025a ) , so what HOI generators can produce is bounded by the interaction data that exists.
paragraphs.zh: 生成三维人类-物体交互（HOI）内容可用于动画、具身人工智能和增强现实领域，从通过 HOI 运动学习的人形控制器和机器人策略（Xu et al., 2025b; Wang et al., 2025b），到以自我为中心的智能助手（Banerjee et al., 2025; Ma et al., 2024; Petrov et al., 2026），以及诸如边携带物体边坐下之类的组合动画（Pan et al., 2025）。 这些应用所针对的活动通常是多物体的：在 KIT 全身动作数据库中，262 个与物体相关的动作中有 99 个涉及两个或更多物体（Mandery et al., 2016）。 与其他生成模型一样，运动生成模型会随着数据量的增加而改进（Wang et al., 2025a; Xu et al., 2025a），因此 HOI 生成器能够生成的内容受限于现有的交互数据。

paragraphs.en: On the data side, HOI datasets mostly record one person with one object ( Taheri et al., 2020 ) , and the generators trained on them inherit this scope ( Xu et al., 2023 ; Diller & Dai, 2024 ; Peng et al., 2025 ) . Capturing several objects at once is expensive, and the cost grows combinatorially with the objects, body parts, and pairings ( Xie et al., 2024 ) , so captured multi-object datasets stay below ten hours ( Lv et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2025 ) , against 21.8 in the single-object collection InterAct ( Xu et al., 2025a ) . On the model side, generators are built for one object ( Diller & Dai, 2024 ; Pi et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2023 ) , and the few multi-object ones train one model per object count ( Lv et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2025 ) or pad a fixed state ( Zhang et al., 2024a ) and leave implicit which body part moves which object. The concurrent SK-HOI ( Peng et al., 2026 ) handles a variable number of objects in three separate stages. There is no multi-object data at single-object scale, and no end-to-end generator for a variable number of objects grounded to the body parts that move them.
paragraphs.zh: 在数据方面，HOI数据集主要记录一个人与一个物体的互动（Taheri等，2020），而基于这些数据集训练的生成模型也继承了这一范围（Xu等，2023；Diller & Dai，2024；Peng等，2025）。 同时捕捉多个物体成本高昂，且该成本会随着物体、身体部位及配对组合的数量呈指数级增长（Xie等，2024），因此已采集的多物体数据集时长均低于十小时（Lv等，2024；Kim等，2025；Lu等，2025），而单物体采集项目InterAct的时长则达到21.8小时（Xu等，2025a）。 在模型方面，生成模型通常针对单个物体构建（Diller & Dai，2024；Pi等，2025；Xu等，2023），而少数支持多物体的模型则按物体数量分别训练不同模型（Lv等，2024；He等，2025），或采用固定状态填充方式（Zhang等，2024a），但未明确说明哪些身体部位会移动哪些物体。 同步开发的SK-HOI（Peng等，2026）通过三个独立阶段处理数量可变的物体。 目前既不存在与单物体规模相当的多物体数据，也没有针对数量可变物体的端到端生成模型，且该模型尚未与驱动这些物体的身体部位建立关联。

paragraphs.en: Synthetic and composed data has closed comparable gaps before ( Black et al., 2023 ; Xie et al., 2024 ; Mandlekar et al., 2023 ) , and closest to our setting, SINC composes simultaneous actions by taking each body part from the clip whose action uses it ( Athanasiou et al., 2023 ) . Our observation is that interactions with objects are local in the same way: a cup is held by a hand, a chair supports the pelvis, a ball is kicked by a foot, and the rest of the body is free. The limb that performs one interaction can therefore be transferred, together with its object, to a body that performs another, and multi-object interactions can be composed from single-object captures ( Fig. 1 ), which exist at scale. The composition is only as good as its gating: from contact-consistent clips of single interactions, a language model decides which can plausibly happen at once, and geometric checks keep only the compositions that stay in contact and free of penetration ( Fig. 2 ). Mirroring the one-handed and one-footed clips balances the left and right hands, which captured interactions skew to the right. The resulting COSMI dataset contains 222k sequences and 275 hours of motion, nearly thirty times the largest captured multi-object dataset ( Lv et al., 2024 ) . Its physical plausibility stays close to the parent captures ( Section A.1 ), and since nothing in the composition is specific to a dataset, it grows by adding a rule rather than a recording session, even from hand-object recordings ( Section 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 合成与组合数据此前已缩小了可比较的差距（Black 等人，2023；Xie 等人，2024；Mandlekar 等人，2023），而在最接近我们设定的研究中，SINC 通过从片段中选取每个身体部位所执行的动作来组合同步动作（Athanasiou 等人，2023）。 我们的观察是，与物体的互动在局部上具有相似性：杯子由手握住，椅子支撑骨盆，球被脚踢出，而身体的其余部分则保持自由。 因此，执行一种互动的肢体可以连同其物体一起转移给执行另一种互动的身体，并且多物体互动可以从单物体捕捉数据中组合而成（图 1），而这些数据已具备大规模存在性。 组合的质量完全取决于其门控机制：从接触一致的单次互动片段中，语言模型会判断哪些动作可能同时发生，而几何检查则仅保留那些保持接触且无穿模的组合（图 2）。 通过镜像单手和单脚片段，可以平衡原本捕捉到的互动偏向右侧的左右手。 由此生成的 COSMI 数据集包含 22.2 万条序列和 275 小时的运动数据，几乎是现有最大多物体捕捉数据集（Lv 等人，2024）的三十倍。 其物理合理性仍与原始捕捉数据高度一致（A.1 节），并且由于组合中的任何内容都不特定于某个数据集，因此只需添加一条规则即可扩展该数据集，而无需新增录制会话，甚至可以从手与物体的记录中实现这一点（第 5 节）。

paragraphs.en: Such data calls for a generator for a variable number of objects. COSMI is a single diffusion transformer that denoises the person and a set of objects from a prompt and initial poses. Its object slots share their weights, so no parameter depends on the object count, and one model generates one to five objects. Each object is predicted relative to the joint that drives it, which a part-assignment head reads from these conditions, and text tokens link the words of the prompt to the objects. On a benchmark that holds out an unseen object and five unseen combinations, such as walking-with-an-apple (while walking-only and apple-eating stay in training), COSMI and the baselines trained on the COSMI dataset alike generalize to the unseen combinations. COSMI outperforms HIMO ( Lv et al., 2024 ) and multi-object adaptations of MDM and PriorMDM ( Tevet et al., 2023 ; Shafir et al., 2024 ) in text alignment and contact accuracy, where its margin is largest on the unseen object.
paragraphs.zh: 这类数据需要一个能够生成可变数量对象的生成器。 COSMI 是一个单一的扩散变换器，它根据提示词和初始姿态对人物及一组对象进行去噪处理。 其对象槽位共享权重，因此没有任何参数依赖于对象数量，一个模型即可生成一个到五个对象。 每个对象都是相对于驱动它的关节进行预测的，部分分配头会从这些条件中读取相关信息，而文本标记则将提示词中的词语与各个对象关联起来。 在一个基准测试中，该测试保留了未见过的对象和五种未见过的组合（例如“边走路边拿苹果”，而“仅行走”和“吃苹果”仍保留在训练数据中），COSMI 以及基于 COSMI 数据集训练的基线模型都能很好地泛化到这些未见过的组合。 在文本对齐和接触准确性方面，COSMI 的表现优于 HIMO（Lv 等人，2024）以及 MDM 和 PriorMDM 的多对象变体（Tevet 等人，2023；Shafir 等人，2024），尤其是在处理未见过的对象时，其优势最为显著。

paragraphs.en: Most full-body interaction datasets, captured with marker-based motion capture or multi-view video, record one person with one object ( Taheri et al., 2020 ; Bhatnagar et al., 2022 ; Huang et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2023b ; Zhao et al., 2024 ) , later also with articulated objects ( Jiang et al., 2023 ; Fan et al., 2023 ) . Full-body datasets with several objects per sequence are recent and small ( Table 1 ): HIMO records two or three small rigid objects ( Lv et al., 2024 ) , ParaHome and HUMOTO articulated household objects ( Kim et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2025 ) , and HOI-M3, CORE4D, and MMHOI several people ( Zhang et al., 2024a ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Kogashi et al., 2026 ) . Hand-object datasets omit the body but record more hours and objects, often several at once ( Hampali et al., 2020 ; Chao et al., 2021 ; Zhan et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Banerjee et al., 2025 ; Fu et al., 2025 ) , and a body fitted to such a recording turns it into a source clip for our pipeline ( Section 5 ). Interaction data has also been generated procedurally, placed into scenes, augmented, or recovered from video ( Xie et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2022 ; Xu et al., 2025a ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Xie et al., 2026 ) , always with one object. The COSMI dataset instead composes these single-object captures into multi-object sequences: every source clip pairs with every compatible target and composed sequences serve as targets again, so the number of sequences grows combinatorially with the clips rather than linearly with recording time ( Table 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 大多数全身交互数据集均通过基于标记的动作捕捉或多视角视频进行采集，记录一人与一个物体之间的互动（Taheri 等，2020；Bhatnagar 等，2022；Huang 等，2024；Li 等，2023；Zhang 等，2023b；Zhao 等，2024），后来也扩展到了可活动关节的物体（Jiang 等，2023；Fan 等，2023）。 每序列包含多个物体的全身数据集出现时间较晚且规模较小（表1）：HIMO 记录了两个或三个小型刚性物体（Lv 等，2024），ParaHome 和 HUMOTO 记录了可活动关节的家居物品（Kim 等，2025；Lu 等，2025），而 HOI-M3、CORE4D 和 MMHOI 则记录了多人互动（Zhang 等，2024a；Liu 等，2025；Kogashi 等，2026）。 手-物体数据集省略了身体部分，但记录的时间更长、物体更多，通常一次会记录多个物体（Hampali 等，2020；Chao 等，2021；Zhan 等，2024；Liu 等，2024；Banerjee 等，2025；Fu 等，2025），而将身体与这类记录相匹配后，即可将其转化为我们处理流程的源片段（第5节）。 交互数据也通过程序化生成、场景布置、增强或从视频中恢复的方式获得（Xie 等，2024；Wang 等，2022；Xu 等，2025a；Zhang 等，2026；Xie 等，2026），且始终只涉及一个物体。 相比之下，COSMI 数据集将这些单物体捕捉片段组合成多物体序列：每个源片段都与所有兼容的目标片段配对，而组合后的序列又可作为新的目标，因此序列数量随着片段数量的组合呈指数级增长，而非随记录时间线性增长（表1）。

paragraphs.en: Animation has long composed captured clips without objects, in time with motion graphs ( Kovar et al., 2002 ) and across body parts by splicing ( Ikemoto & Forsyth, 2004 ; Heck et al., 2006 ) . SINC revisits spatial composition with language, composing the body parts of two clips into training data from GPT-3 part labels, and leaves the semantic compatibility to future work ( Athanasiou et al., 2023 ) . Later models annotate, coordinate, or blend parts ( Li et al., 2026 ; Zou et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) or compose actions in time at inference ( Athanasiou et al., 2022 ; Shafir et al., 2024 ; Petrovich et al., 2024 ; Barquero et al., 2024 ) . Language models also plan compositions at inference, as contact chains, joint-contact pairs, affordance graphs, or plans ( Xiao et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024b ; Li & Dai, 2026 ; Xu et al., 2024 ; Sun et al., 2026 ) , while we use one offline to infer the semantic plausibility of clip combinations ( Section 3 ). Composed training data exists for multi-person motion, by random placement ( Shan et al., 2024 ) or with LLM guidance and a learned filter ( Wu et al., 2026 ) , and for interactions only as static poses ( Zhao et al., 2022 ) or as segments and models composed at inference ( Lv et al., 2024 ; Na et al., 2025 ) . We extend body-part composition to interactions with objects, at the data level and across datasets, with object transfer across bodies, semantic gating, and physical checks.
paragraphs.zh: 动画长期以来一直通过运动图（Kovar 等人，2002）来合成没有物体的片段，并通过拼接（Ikemoto & Forsyth，2004；Heck 等人，2006）实现跨身体部位的合成。 SINC 重新探讨了基于语言的空间合成方法，它利用 GPT-3 的身体部位标签将两个片段的身体部位组合成训练数据，而语义兼容性则留待未来研究（Athanasiou 等人，2023）。 后续模型能够标注、协调或融合身体部位（Li 等人，2026；Zou 等人，2024；Jiang 等人，2025），或在推理阶段按时间顺序合成动作（Athanasiou 等人，2022；Shafir 等人，2024；Petrovich 等人，2024；Barquero 等人，2024）。 语言模型在推理阶段也能规划合成方案，例如接触链、关节接触对、可用性图或计划（Xiao 等人，2024；Wang 等人，2024b；Li & Dai，2026；Xu 等人，2024；Sun 等人，2026），而我们的方法则使用一种离线模型来推断片段组合的语义合理性（第 3 节）。 多人运动的合成训练数据已经存在，这些数据的生成方式包括随机放置（Shan 等人，2024）或在大型语言模型（LLM）引导和已学习过滤器的辅助下生成（Wu 等人，2026）；而交互相关的合成数据目前仅以静态姿势（Zhao 等人，2022）或推理阶段合成的片段与模型形式存在（Lv 等人，2024；Na 等人，2025）。 我们将身体部位的合成方法扩展到与物体的交互，涵盖数据层面和跨数据集的整合，并实现了物体在不同身体之间的转移、语义门控以及物理合理性检查。

paragraphs.en: Text-to-motion generation rests on diffusion and token models trained on HumanML3D ( Guo et al., 2022 ; Tevet et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2024b ; Chen et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2023a ; Guo et al., 2024 ) and, recently, on million-clip corpora ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , two orders of magnitude larger than any captured interaction dataset. Interaction generators extend them to a body and one object ( Ghosh et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Peng et al., 2025 ; Diller & Dai, 2024 ; Xu et al., 2024 ; Petrov et al., 2025 ; Ron et al., 2026 ; Ji et al., 2026 ; Pan et al., 2026 ; Jung et al., 2026 ; Cai et al., 2026 ) , including articulated ones ( Pi et al., 2025 ) , and grasp synthesis models the fingers in contact ( Taheri et al., 2022 ; Wu et al., 2022 ; Zhang et al., 2021 ; Cha et al., 2024 ; Christen et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Generators for several objects are few: HIMO trains separate models for two and three objects ( Lv et al., 2024 ) , SyncDiff one model per object configuration, conditioned on label phrases ( He et al., 2025 ) , and Dex2HOI one stream per object for at most two, both in the hands ( Pratikaki et al., 2026 ) . HOI-M3 pads a preset state and takes no text ( Zhang et al., 2024a ) , and HOI-PAGE optimizes each sequence zero-shot for minutes ( Li & Dai, 2026 ) . The concurrent SK-HOI covers a variable number of objects with zero-padded slots, but generates in three separately trained stages followed by minutes of test-time optimization per sequence ( Peng et al., 2026 ) . COSMI instead is one text-conditioned diffusion transformer with no parameter tied to the object count, which generates one to five objects, articulated and worn, in a single stage and grounds the objects to the body parts that move them.

paragraphs.en: We build every sequence of the COSMI dataset from captured single-object interactions and motions, combined on one body. Our goal is to obtain semantically plausible multi-object interactions from these atomic clips. We therefore extract contact-consistent clips from the source sequences, annotate them with semantic information from a language model, and mirror them to balance the left and right hands. paragraphs.en: We build the dataset from atomic clips , segments in which a person performs a single interaction and stays in contact with the object from the first frame to the last, so that the acting limb and the object can be lifted out with their contact intact. Holds and worn objects reduce to a single representative frame, and the walking rule admits whole sequences. In composition, source rules cover the manipulation of small objects with one or both hands and passive holds (GRAB, ARCTIC). Target rules cover the interactions that engage the whole body, sitting, moving large objects, foot interactions, and walking (BEHAVE, InterCap, OMOMO, AMASS), and augmentation rules the worn backpack and eyeglasses (BEHAVE, GRAB).

paragraphs.en: Whether two interactions can plausibly be performed simultaneously is a semantic question: a person can browse a phone while sitting, but not browse a phone while taking a picture with a camera, although one hand is free for each. Composition therefore needs to know what every clip captures, which the labels of the source datasets, written for whole recordings in differing forms, do not tell. We extract this information with a language model, Qwen3 ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , which names the sustained interaction with a verb, correcting labels that are wrong or too general, and writes one sentence, such as “A person drinks from a cup with the right hand.” (prompts in Section C.3 ). Per action and object, it further marks whether the action requires gaze at the object and involves the head , as drinking, eating, and calling do, which decides what can happen at once.
paragraphs.zh: 两种互动能否合理地在同一时间进行，是一个语义问题：一个人可以在坐着时浏览手机，但无法在拍照的同时浏览手机，尽管每种情况都有一只手是空闲的。 因此，组合需要知道每个片段捕捉到了什么内容，而源数据集的标签——这些标签是为不同形式的完整记录编写的——并未提供这一信息。 我们使用语言模型 Qwen3（Yang et al., 2025）提取这些信息，该模型会用动词命名持续进行的互动，纠正错误或过于笼统的标签，并生成一句描述，例如“一个人用右手从杯子中喝水。”（提示见第 C.3 节）。 对于每个动作和物体，该模型还会标注该动作是否需要注视物体以及是否涉及头部，例如喝水、进食和通话都需要，这决定了哪些动作可以同时进行。

We pair a target clip, which provides the body motion, with a source clip, whose action is added on a free limb, if the two are compatible at two levels. The composition graph settles which interactions can share a body ( Fig. 2 ): whole-body targets accept every source, and a one-hand target or a hand action accepts the other hand. Within a permitted pair, the semantic annotations decide whether the two actions can plausibly happen at once: a person cannot attend to two objects simultaneously, so two actions that both require gaze or both involve the head follow each other in sequence, a right- and a left-hand action on a sitting, walking, or standing body with a blended transition. Other pairs are composed simultaneously: the source limb, with the head and spine when the action needs them, replaces its counterpart on the target body, and its object follows through Eq. 1 . We keep a composition only if it is physically plausible: every object keeps the contacts of its rule, the body does not penetrate itself, and no object penetrates another ( Section C.7 ). Enumerating the graph exhaustively, with composed sequences serving as targets again, yields one- to three-object levels and a sequential level, and worn objects are added at every level, up to five objects per sequence. Captions are assembled from the annotations by a template and paraphrased.
paragraphs.zh: 如果两个片段在两个层面上兼容，我们就会将一个提供身体动作的目标片段与一个源片段配对，该源片段的动作会添加到一个自由肢体上。 构图图决定了哪些交互可以共享一个身体（图 2）：全身目标接受所有源片段，而单手目标或手部动作则接受另一只手。 在允许的配对中，语义标注会决定这两个动作是否可能同时发生：一个人无法同时关注两个物体，因此需要注视或涉及头部的两个动作会依次发生；而坐立、行走或站立的身体上，右手和左手动作会通过混合过渡依次执行。 其他配对则被同时组合：源肢体（若动作需要，还包括头部和脊柱）会取代目标身体上的对应部分，其作用对象则通过公式 1 确定。 只有当构图在物理上是合理的，我们才会保留它：每个物体都保持其规则所规定的接触关系，身体不会穿透自身，且没有任何物体穿透其他物体（C.7 节）。 通过穷举枚举该图，并将已组合的序列再次作为目标，可以得到一个到三个物体的层级以及一个序列层级；在每个层级中都会添加已使用的物体，每序列最多可达五个物体。 标题由模板和转述的标注组合而成。

sents.en: We pair a target clip, which provides the body motion, with a source clip, whose action is added on a free limb, if the two are compatible at two levels.

sents.en: The composition graph settles which interactions can share a body ( Fig. 2 ): whole-body targets accept every source, and a one-hand target or a hand action accepts the other hand.
sents.zh: 构图图决定了哪些交互可以共享一个身体（图 2）：全身目标接受所有源片段，而单手目标或手部动作则接受另一只手。

sents.en: Within a permitted pair, the semantic annotations decide whether the two actions can plausibly happen at once: a person cannot attend to two objects simultaneously, so two actions that both require gaze or both involve the head follow each other in sequence, a right- and a left-hand action on a sitting, walking, or standing body with a blended transition.
sents.zh: 在允许的配对中，语义标注会决定这两个动作是否可能同时发生：一个人无法同时关注两个物体，因此需要注视或涉及头部的两个动作会依次发生；而坐立、行走或站立的身体上，右手和左手动作会通过混合过渡依次执行。

sents.en: Other pairs are composed simultaneously: the source limb, with the head and spine when the action needs them, replaces its counterpart on the target body, and its object follows through Eq. 1 .
sents.zh: 其他配对则被同时组合：源肢体（若动作需要，还包括头部和脊柱）会取代目标身体上的对应部分，其作用对象则通过公式 1 确定。

sents.en: We keep a composition only if it is physically plausible: every object keeps the contacts of its rule, the body does not penetrate itself, and no object penetrates another ( Section C.7 ).
sents.zh: 只有当构图在物理上是合理的，我们才会保留它：每个物体都保持其规则所规定的接触关系，身体不会穿透自身，且没有任何物体穿透其他物体（C.7 节）。

sents.en: Enumerating the graph exhaustively, with composed sequences serving as targets again, yields one- to three-object levels and a sequential level, and worn objects are added at every level, up to five objects per sequence.
sents.zh: 通过穷举枚举该图，并将已组合的序列再次作为目标，可以得到一个到三个物体的层级以及一个序列层级；在每个层级中都会添加已使用的物体，每序列最多可达五个物体。

sents.en: Captions are assembled from the annotations by a template and paraphrased.
sents.zh: 标题由模板和转述的标注组合而成。

Every composed sequence inherits the capture quality of its parents, which we verify with the metrics of HUMOTO ( Lu et al., 2025 ) on the composed sequences and on their parent recordings ( Section A.1 ). Foot sliding is unchanged, since composition alters neither the lower body nor the global trajectory, and jerk and penetration change by less than the captured datasets differ among themselves, human jerk the most, by up to half.

paragraphs.en: Nothing in the composition is specific to a source dataset: the rules are stated by contacts, pose constraints, and reference joints on the unified body, so any clip on this body enters through a rule, as the AMASS walking sequences do. Partial observations enter as well, since every interaction is stored relative to the body part that performs it. A hand-object recording becomes a source clip once a body is fitted to it, which is less obvious, so we demonstrate it with HOT3D ( Section 5 ). The exhaustive enumeration also makes generalization testable: a pairing such as walking with an apple can be held out as a whole while walking and eating an apple remain in training. Our benchmark builds on this and tests how well a model generalizes to five such unseen combinations and to an unseen object, held out with all its sequences ( Section 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 该组合中的任何内容都不特定于某个源数据集：规则由接触点、姿态约束以及对统一身体上参考关节的引用来定义，因此该身体上的任何片段都通过一条规则进入，正如 AMASS 行走序列那样。 部分观察也会进入系统，因为每次交互都是相对于执行该交互的身体部位存储的。 一旦为手-物体记录拟合了一个身体，它便会成为一个源片段，这一点不太直观，因此我们使用 HOT3D（第 5 节）来加以演示。 这种穷举枚举也使得泛化能力可以接受检验：例如，将“携带苹果行走”作为一个整体排除在外，而“行走和吃苹果”仍保留在训练数据中。 我们的基准测试在此基础上进一步验证了模型对五个此类未见组合以及一个未见过物体的泛化能力，该物体连同其所有序列都被排除在训练数据之外（第 5 节）。

paragraphs.en: COSMI is a single text-conditioned model for a variable number of objects ( Fig. 3 ): no parameter depends on the object count, so one model generates interactions with one to five objects, articulated and worn ones included, in a single denoising pass. paragraphs.zh: COSMI 是一个仅通过文本条件约束的模型，适用于数量可变的物体（图 3）：没有任何参数取决于物体数量，因此一个模型即可在一次降噪过程中生成与一个到五个物体之间的交互，包括可活动关节和可穿戴的物体。 给定提示 𝒲 \mathcal{W}、人物的初始姿态以及一组 N 个物体（每个物体由网格、名称和初始姿态定义），该模型会生成人物运动 ℋ \mathcal{H} 和物体运动 𝒪 1 , … , 𝒪 N \mathcal{O}_{1},\dots,\mathcal{O}_{N}，覆盖 W = 120 帧，即 30 fps 下的 4 秒。

paragraphs.en: The text prompt is encoded with CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) and enters the model both as a pooled sentence embedding and as the sequence of word-piece embeddings, the text tokens 𝒲 \mathcal{W} . Following HIMO ( Lv et al., 2024 ) , we also condition on the first frame of the window, the initial pose of the person and of every object. Each object is further described by its name and by an embedding of its geometry, computed from basis point set features ( Prokudin et al., 2019 ) with a hierarchical encoder ( Section D.3 ). Since the object names appear in the captions and are encoded with the same CLIP model, the text tokens, as in MotionDiffuse ( Zhang et al., 2024b ) , let every object be related to the words that refer to it, which the pooled embedding cannot.
paragraphs.zh: 文本提示通过 CLIP（Radford 等人，2021）进行编码，并以池化句子嵌入和词片嵌入序列（文本标记 𝒲 \mathcal{W}）两种形式输入模型。 遵循 HIMO（Lv 等人，2024），我们还以窗口中的第一帧、人物的初始姿态以及每个物体的初始姿态为条件。 每个物体还通过其名称和几何形状嵌入进行进一步描述，其中几何形状嵌入基于基础点集特征（Prokudin 等人，2019）通过分层编码器（D.3 节）计算得出。 由于物体名称出现在说明文字中且使用相同的 CLIP 模型进行编码，因此文本标记（与 MotionDiffuse（Zhang 等人，2024b）中的做法一致）使得每个物体都能与其对应的词语建立关联，而池化嵌入则无法实现这一点。

paragraphs.en: The denoiser COSMI ψ \mathrm{COSMI}_{\psi} is a transformer ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) with one token per frame of the human motion ℋ \mathcal{H} and of every object motion 𝒪 n \mathcal{O}_{n} , all attending to each other and to the conditioning tokens. Since attention cost grows quadratically with the tokens, we chunk every four frames of an object into one token. A smoothing convolution decodes the output tokens to per-frame parameters, without which the object motion has a seam every four frames ( Section D.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 去噪器 COSMI ψ \mathrm{COSMI}_{\psi} 是一种 Transformer（Vaswani 等人，2017），其中每一帧的人类运动 ℋ \mathcal{H} 和每个物体运动 𝒪 n \mathcal{O}_{n} 都对应一个 token，所有 token 彼此之间以及与条件 token 之间都存在注意力关联。 由于注意力成本随 token 数量呈二次方增长，我们将每个物体的每四帧合并为一个 token。 一种平滑卷积将输出 token 解码为每帧的参数；若没有这种处理，物体运动每四帧就会出现接缝（D.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: The token streams of the objects, which we call slots, receive no slot-specific embedding: all slots share the input and output projections and differ only in their conditioning, and masks exclude empty slots from attention and from the per-object losses. The network is therefore permutation-equivariant with respect to the objects, and none of its parameters depends on their number, which is set at run time rather than in the architecture, with up to five slots in training.
paragraphs.zh: 我们称为“槽位”的对象所拥有的令牌流不会接收任何特定的槽位嵌入：所有槽位共享输入和输出投影，仅在其条件信息上存在差异，而掩码则会将空槽位排除在注意机制和每个对象的损失计算之外。 因此，该网络相对于对象而言是置换等变的，其任何参数都不依赖于对象的数量——这一数量是在运行时而非架构中设定的，训练时最多允许五个槽位。

sents.en: The network is therefore permutation-equivariant with respect to the objects, and none of its parameters depends on their number, which is set at run time rather than in the architecture, with up to five slots in training.
sents.zh: 因此，该网络相对于对象而言是置换等变的，其任何参数都不依赖于对象的数量——这一数量是在运行时而非架构中设定的，训练时最多允许五个槽位。

paragraphs.en: We say that a joint j ∈ 𝒥 rel j\in\mathcal{J}_{\mathrm{rel}} drives an object if the object moves with this joint: an object held in a hand, worn on the head or back, or kicked with a foot is driven by the wrist, head, spine, or foot. A chair, in contrast, is not driven but only supports the person who sits on it. A lightweight transformer head predicts the driving joints of every object from the conditions alone, supervised with labels derived from contacts and joint motion ( Section D.5 ). Its prediction enters the denoiser as an additional input and selects the decoding: a driven object is placed through the relative pose 𝑻 𝒪 | j t \bm{T}_{\mathcal{O}|j}^{t} of its driving joint, and an undriven object keeps its absolute pose 𝑻 𝒪 t \bm{T}_{\mathcal{O}}^{t} .
paragraphs.zh: 如果某个物体随着关节 j ∈ 𝒥 rel j\in\mathcal{J}_{\mathrm{rel}} 的运动而移动，我们就称该关节驱动了该物体：例如，被手握住、戴在头部或背部，或用脚踢的物体，分别由手腕、头部、脊柱或脚部驱动。 相比之下，椅子并不会驱动人，而只是为坐在上面的人提供支撑。 一个轻量级的 Transformer 头仅根据条件预测每个物体的驱动关节，其训练由接触点和关节运动推导出的标签监督（见 D.5 节）。 其预测结果作为额外输入进入去噪器，并决定解码方式：被驱动的物体通过其驱动关节的相对位姿 𝑻 𝒪 | j t \bm{T}_{\mathcal{O}|j}^{t} 进行放置，而未受驱动的物体则保持其绝对位姿 𝑻 𝒪 t \bm{T}_{\mathcal{O}}^{t}。

paragraphs.en: A split by subject, the common choice for captured datasets, says little about generalization here, because the clips of a held-out subject would still occur in thousands of training sequences. Instead, we split by composition and hold out what a multi-object model is expected to generalize to. The unseen object is the black chair, held out with all its sequences, a new instance of a seat category whose other members remain in training, so the model has to keep the person seated on it from its geometry, name, and initial pose. The unseen combinations are five pairings whose parts are common in training but never occur together: walking with an apple, sitting with a flip phone, a camera together with a mug, a foot interaction while drinking, and standing with a water bottle. The held-out sequences form the test set, 35k sequences against 187k for training.
paragraphs.zh: 按主体进行划分是捕获数据集的常见做法，但在此处对泛化能力几乎没有任何说明，因为被保留主体的片段仍会出现在数千个训练序列中。 相反，我们按构图进行划分，并保留多对象模型需要实现泛化的内容。 未见的对象是黑色椅子，它的所有序列都被保留在外；这是座位类别的一个新实例，该类别的其他成员仍保留在训练数据中，因此模型必须根据椅子的几何形状、名称和初始姿态来识别坐在上面的人。 未见的组合包括五种配对：这些组合的组成部分在训练数据中很常见，但从未同时出现——即边走动边拿苹果、坐着时使用翻盖手机、相机与马克杯一起出现、饮水时脚部有互动，以及站着时拿着水瓶。 被保留的序列构成了测试集，包含 3.5 万个序列，而训练集则有 18.7 万个序列。

paragraphs.en: We train a single model on all training sequences and evaluate the same weights throughout. The two-object and three-object tiers follow the setting of HIMO ( Lv et al., 2024 ) , test sequences with exactly two or three rigid interacted objects and no worn objects, and the all-objects tier contains every test sequence, with one to five objects, articulated and worn included. Every test sequence is generated three times over its full length from its caption and initial poses.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在所有训练序列上训练一个单一模型，并在整个过程中评估相同的权重。 双物体和三物体层级遵循 HIMO（Lv 等人，2024）的设置：测试序列包含恰好两个或三个刚性互作用的物体，且没有穿戴的物体；而全物体层级则包含所有测试序列，其中物体数量从一到五个不等，包括可活动关节和穿戴的物体。 每个测试序列都会根据其描述和初始姿态，沿着其完整长度生成三次。

sents.en: The two-object and three-object tiers follow the setting of HIMO ( Lv et al., 2024 ) , test sequences with exactly two or three rigid interacted objects and no worn objects, and the all-objects tier contains every test sequence, with one to five objects, articulated and worn included.
sents.zh: 双物体和三物体层级遵循 HIMO（Lv 等人，2024）的设置：测试序列包含恰好两个或三个刚性互作用的物体，且没有穿戴的物体；而全物体层级则包含所有测试序列，其中物体数量从一到五个不等，包括可活动关节和穿戴的物体。

sents.en: Every test sequence is generated three times over its full length from its caption and initial poses.
sents.zh: 每个测试序列都会根据其描述和初始姿态，沿着其完整长度生成三次。

paragraphs.en: A learned evaluator, a text-motion co-embedding trained on our training split, provides FID ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) , R-precision (top-1 and top-3), multimodal distance (MM-Dist), and diversity, the metrics of text-to-motion generation ( Guo et al., 2022 ; Lv et al., 2024 ) . Foot sliding and object jerk follow HUMOTO ( Lu et al., 2025 ) , penetration counts the frames in which the body enters an object, and all three are measured on the decoded meshes. Temporal and body contact accuracy (T-Acc, B-Acc) ( Peng et al., 2026 ) compare the generated body-object contacts with those of the ground truth per frame and per body marker. For articulated objects, we report the hinge-angle error and the sweep ratio of the generated to the ground-truth hinge motion, and all values are means over three generations (definitions in Appendix B ).
paragraphs.zh: 一个经过学习的评估器——在训练集上训练的文本-动作联合嵌入模型——提供 FID（Heusel 等，2017）、R-precision（top-1 和 top-3）、多模态距离（MM-Dist）以及多样性，这些是文本到动作生成任务的指标（Guo 等，2022；Lv 等，2024）。 脚部滑动和物体抖动遵循 HUMOTO（Lu 等，2025），穿透次数统计身体进入物体的帧数，这三项指标均在解码后的网格上测量。 时间性和身体接触准确性（T-Acc、B-Acc）（Peng 等，2026）通过逐帧、逐身体标记点的方式，将生成的身体与物体接触与真实数据中的接触进行比较。 对于可活动关节的物体，我们报告铰链角度误差以及生成铰链运动与真实铰链运动之间的扫掠比率，所有数值均为三次生成结果的平均值（定义见附录 B）。

paragraphs.en: The closest prior work is HIMO ( Lv et al., 2024 ) , whose benchmark also adapts MDM ( Tevet et al., 2023 ) and PriorMDM ( Shafir et al., 2024 ) to several objects. We re-implement MDM and PriorMDM on our representation with our initial-pose conditioning, schedule, and losses, but with a pooled text embedding and a small geometry encoder, so that each is a single model evaluated in all tiers. MDM has one token per frame, whereas PriorMDM has separate human and object streams with one communication block. HIMO supports rigid objects only, so its two models are trained on the two- and three-object tiers in its format and scored with our evaluator. The concurrent SK-HOI ( Peng et al., 2026 ) is not compared, since its full code is unavailable and its test-time optimization of about four minutes per sequence is out of reach for 35k sequences.
paragraphs.zh: 最接近的前期工作是 HIMO（Lv 等人，2024），其基准测试也将 MDM（Tevet 等人，2023）和 PriorMDM（Shafir 等人，2024）适配到多个物体上。 我们使用我们的初始姿态条件、调度机制和损失函数，在我们的表示上重新实现了 MDM 和 PriorMDM，但采用了共享的文本嵌入和一个小型几何编码器，因此每个模型都是一个在全部层级中评估的单模型。 MDM 每帧只有一个标记，而 PriorMDM 则包含独立的人类和物体流，以及一个通信模块。 HIMO 仅支持刚性物体，因此其两个模型是在其格式的两物体和三物体层级上训练的，并使用我们的评估器进行评分。 同时发布的 SK-HOI（Peng 等人，2026）未被纳入比较，因为其完整代码不可用，且其在测试时每个序列约四分钟的优化时间对于 35,000 个序列而言难以实现。

paragraphs.en: Tables 2 and 5 compare the methods in the all-objects tier, COSMI with the contact-consistent guidance of Section 4 . COSMI obtains the best FID, R-precision, MM-Dist, and foot sliding, and its penetration stays at the ground-truth level, the residual penetration of the captures, which the baselines exceed. COSMI has the lowest hinge-angle error but the smallest hinge sweep, two thirds of the ground truth ( Section A.6 ). The two- and three-object tiers agree ( Table 3 ), the baselines up to seventeen points above the ground-truth penetration with two objects, except that HIMO, trained per tier, has the best top-3 R-precision with three objects.
paragraphs.zh: 表2和表5比较了全对象层级中COSMI方法与第4节所述的接触一致性引导方法。 COSMI在FID、R-精度、MM-Dist和脚部滑动方面表现最佳，且其穿透性保持在真实值水平，即捕捉中的残余穿透性，而基线方法均超过了该水平。 COSMI的铰链角度误差最低，但铰链扫掠范围最小，仅为真实值的三分之二（见A.6节）。 二对象和三对象层级的结果一致（见表3）：在两个对象的情况下，基线方法的穿透性最多比真实值高十七个点；但在三个对象的情况下，按层级分别训练的HIMO方法在前三名的R-精度方面表现最佳。

paragraphs.en: Everyday activities combine objects in countless ways, from drinking while sitting to eating an apple while walking, and the combinations to capture grow faster than any recording effort. The COSMI dataset shows that they need not all be recorded: interactions are local, so a contact-consistent clip of one interaction carries its limb and object onto a body that performs another. A language model and geometric checks admit only the combinations that a person would plausibly perform and that remain physically valid, so what emerges is not stitched clips but semantically meaningful, realistic multi-object interactions. The result is 222k sequences and 275 hours with up to five objects, balanced between the hands by mirroring and nearly as plausible as their captures. Nothing in the composition is tied to a source dataset, so every further capture multiplies the combinations, full-body datasets through a rule and hand-object recordings once a body is fitted to them, as HOT3D shows. The COSMI method, a text-driven diffusion transformer grounding the objects to the body parts that move them, generates a variable number of objects end to end. The baselines and COSMI alike generalize to combinations never seen in training, and COSMI also to an unseen object.
paragraphs.zh: 日常活动以无数种方式组合物体，从坐着喝水到边走边吃苹果，这些组合的捕捉速度比任何记录尝试都要快。 COSMI数据集表明，并非所有互动都需要被记录：互动是局部发生的，因此一段接触一致的单一互动片段，会将肢体和物体延续到执行另一互动的身体上。 语言模型和几何检查仅允许那些人类可能执行且物理上有效的组合，因此最终呈现的并非拼接的片段，而是具有语义意义且逼真的多物体互动。 结果包括22.2万条序列和275小时的数据，其中最多包含五个物体，通过镜像实现双手平衡，其可信度几乎与捕捉数据相当。 组合中的任何内容都与源数据集无关，因此每次新的捕捉都会使组合数量倍增；一旦身体被适配到全身体数据集和手-物体记录中，这些组合便会进一步扩展，正如HOT3D所示。 COSMI方法是一种文本驱动的扩散变换器，它将物体与移动它们的身体部位进行绑定，并能端到端地生成数量可变的物体。 基线模型和COSMI都能泛化到训练数据中从未见过的组合，而COSMI还能处理未见过的物体。

paragraphs.en: The composition covers sustained single interactions at once or in sequence. Extending it to multi-stage activities such as cooking or assembling, whose steps and objects depend on each other, and bringing the data together with interactable scenes, where a cup is taken from a shelf on the way, are the directions we consider most promising. On the method side, the guidance closes the gaps between fingers and objects, but the finger motion has yet to reach the precision of dedicated grasp synthesis. Finally, text is a coarse interface: the prompt fixes the objects and actions, but not the path of the person or the timing of sequential actions.
paragraphs.zh: 该构成涵盖一次性或依次进行的持续单一交互。 将其扩展至多阶段活动（如烹饪或组装），其步骤和对象相互依赖，并将数据与可交互场景结合——例如途中从架子上取下一个杯子——这些是我们认为最有前景的方向。 在方法层面，该引导机制填补了手指与物体之间的间隙，但手指运动尚未达到专用抓取合成那样的精度。 最后，文本是一种粗略的接口：提示词固定了物体和动作，但未规定人物的路径或连续动作的时间安排。

paragraphs.en: Abstract. This appendix extends the experiments of the main paper and completes the description of the dataset and the method. In Appendix A , we measure the quality of the composed sequences against their parent recordings, ablate the components of the COSMI method, compare with HIMO on its own dataset, and present qualitative results and failure cases. We also show that hand-object recordings enter the composition once a body is fitted to them, and we render composed sequences on clothed scans. In Appendix B , we define the evaluator behind the learned metrics and the physical metrics with their thresholds and units. In Appendix C , we detail the construction of the dataset, from the preprocessing of the sources and the interaction rules to the mirroring that balances the hands and the feasibility checks of the composition. Finally, in Appendix D , we describe the COSMI method in full, including the representations of the person and the objects, the architecture, the training objective, and the contact-consistent guidance.
paragraphs.zh: 摘要。 本附录扩展了主论文中的实验，并完整描述了数据集与方法。 在附录 A 中，我们通过与原始录音对比来评估合成序列的质量，对 COSMI 方法的各个组件进行了消融分析，与 HIMO 在其自身数据集上的表现进行了比较，并展示了定性结果与失败案例。 我们还表明，一旦为手-物体录音拟合了身体，它们就会进入合成过程，并且我们在带有衣物的扫描数据上渲染了合成序列。 在附录 B 中，我们定义了学习指标背后的评估器以及物理指标及其阈值和单位。 在附录 C 中，我们详细描述了数据集的构建过程，包括来源数据的预处理、交互规则、用于平衡双手的镜像处理，以及合成的可行性检查。 最后，在附录 D 中，我们完整介绍了 COSMI 方法，包括人物与物体的表示方式、架构、训练目标以及接触一致性引导机制。

paragraphs.en: changes one component of the model at a time. Guidance reduces foot sliding by a fifth and closes the finger-object gaps: on 512 test windows, the share of predicted contacts that violate their bound ( Eq. 9 ) by more than 5 mm drops from 18.9 % to 0.9 %. Text alignment and contact accuracy stay unchanged, since the guidance enforces the predicted contacts rather than correcting them, at the cost of slightly more object jerk and penetration. The other variants are sampled without guidance and compare with the unguided model. The auxiliary losses matter most: without them, foot sliding doubles and temporal contact accuracy drops by 17 points. The part assignment improves both text alignment and contacts, whereas the text tokens and the object names improve the text alignment only, by two and one points of top-1 R-precision. Replacing the hierarchical geometry encoder by an MLP changes little, slightly worse top-3 R-precision and multimodal distance against a better FID and object jerk, and the chunk size of four balances single-frame object tokens, which lower the temporal contact accuracy by two points, against chunks of eight, which lower the top-1 R-precision by two points.

paragraphs.en: Figure 6 compares COSMI with the baselines on test prompts of the three-object and the all-objects tier, all from the unseen object or combinations. paragraphs.en: HOT3D ( Banerjee et al., 2025 ) provides the trajectory of the head-mounted device, MANO ( Romero et al., 2017 ) hand poses, and object poses. For every object, we keep the segments in which the head is stable and exactly one object is lifted and in contact with a hand, and place a neutral SMPL-X template with its head at the tracked head position, facing the object. The rotations of the upper body are then optimized so that the SMPL-X hand vertices match the MANO hands and the head faces the object, with a pose prior and a temporal smoothness term, and the finger poses are copied from MANO. The resulting clips contain a full body with the recorded hands and object, and the interaction rules process them like any other source clip, so HOT3D objects can be composed onto the walking, sitting, and large-object targets of the dataset ( Fig. 8 ).
paragraphs.zh: HOT3D（Banerjee 等人，2025）提供了头戴设备的轨迹、MANO（Romero 等人，2017）的手部姿态以及物体姿态。 对于每个物体，我们保留头部稳定且仅有一个物体被举起并与手接触的片段，并将一个中性的 SMPL-X 模板放置到追踪到的头部位置，使其面向该物体。 接着优化上半身的旋转，使 SMPL-X 的手部顶点与 MANO 的手部匹配，并使头部朝向物体，同时加入姿态先验和时序平滑项，手指姿态则从 MANO 中复制。 生成的片段包含完整的身体、记录下来的手部动作和物体，交互规则会像处理其他任何源片段一样处理这些片段，因此 HOT3D 的物体可以被组合到数据集中行走、坐姿以及携带大物体的目标上（图 8）。

paragraphs.en: We use the SMPL-X+D registrations from ( Kostyrko et al., 2026 ) of the 4D-DRESS scans ( Wang et al., 2024a ) , per-vertex displacements on top of the body model, which we animate through the SMPL-X skinning weights with the joint transforms of the composed sequence. paragraphs.en: The learned metrics follow the text-to-motion protocol ( Guo et al., 2022 ) with an evaluator trained on our training split. A sequence is described per frame by the 24 joint positions and, per object slot, the 6D rotation, the center of mass, the hinge channel, and a presence flag, z-scored with the training statistics. A convolutional movement encoder, trained first as an autoencoder on 64-frame snippets and downsampling by four, feeds a bidirectional GRU motion encoder. The motion encoder is trained together with a projection of the frozen CLIP text embedding into a common 512-dimensional space with a contrastive margin loss, margin 3, where pairs with identical canonical captions are never negatives. R-precision and MM-Dist are computed on pools of 32 sequences, FID between the embeddings of the generations and of the ground-truth sequences, and diversity over 100 random pairs, each averaged over the three generations and reported with its 95 % confidence interval. As these metrics depend on the evaluator, we compare them only between methods scored with the same evaluator. Multimodality (MModal.), reported on the HIMO dataset only, is the mean distance between the embeddings of generations for the same caption, as in HIMO.
paragraphs.zh: 所学习的指标遵循文本到运动协议（Guo 等人，2022），并使用在我们的训练集上训练的评估器进行评估。 每个帧由 24 个关节位置描述，每个对象槽则由 6D 旋转、质心、铰链通道和一个存在标志描述，这些值均基于训练统计数据进行了 z-分数标准化。 一个卷积运动编码器首先作为自编码器在 64 帧片段上进行训练，并以四倍下采样，随后将输出送入双向 GRU 运动编码器。 该运动编码器与冻结的 CLIP 文本嵌入到一个共同 512 维空间的投影一同训练，采用对比度余量损失（余量为 3），其中具有相同规范标题的配对绝不会被视为负例。 R-precision 和 MM-Dist 在 32 个序列的池上计算；FID 则比较生成序列与真实序列嵌入之间的差异；多样性则在 100 对随机序列上计算，每对序列在三代结果中取平均，并报告其 95% 置信区间。 由于这些指标依赖于评估器，因此我们仅比较使用相同评估器评分的方法之间的结果。 多模态性（MModal.）仅在 HIMO 数据集上报告，其定义为同一标题下各生成结果的嵌入之间的平均距离，与 HIMO 中的定义一致。

paragraphs.en: Foot sliding ( Li et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2025 ) is the horizontal displacement of the ankle and toe joints in frames where they are below a height threshold H H , 8 cm for the ankles and 4 cm for the toes, which is one on the floor and zero at the threshold, summed, divided by the number of frames, and averaged over the four joints, in mm per frame. Object jerk is the mean norm of the third temporal difference of the object position, as in HUMOTO ( Lu et al., 2025 ) , in cm per frame 3 . Penetration is the fraction of frames in which a body vertex lies deeper than 2 cm inside an object, the collision metric of SK-HOI ( Peng et al., 2026 ) . Table 5 instead uses the definitions of HUMOTO, whose penetration is the deepest intrusion of the body or hands into the object, averaged over frames. For the contact accuracy ( Peng et al., 2026 ) , a body marker is in contact when it lies within 2 cm of the object surface: T-Acc is the accuracy of the per-frame contact state, where a frame is in contact when any of the 138 markers is, and B-Acc the accuracy of the per-marker states. The hinge-angle error is the mean absolute difference between the generated and the ground-truth hinge angle, wrapped to [ − π , π ] [-\pi,\pi] , in radians, and the sweep ratio divides the total hinge motion of a generated sequence by that of the ground truth. The 95 % confidence intervals of these metrics are below 0.02, and below 0.2 percentage points for penetration.
paragraphs.zh: 足部滑动（Li et al., 2024；Lu et al., 2025）是指踝关节和脚趾关节在高度低于阈值 H H 的帧中的水平位移，其中踝关节的阈值为 8 厘米，脚趾关节为 4 厘米；该指标在阈值处取值为 0，在地面上取值为 1，然后将所有值相加，除以帧数，再对四个关节求平均，单位为毫米/帧。 物体抖动是物体位置在时间上的三阶差分向量的平均范数，如 HUMOTO（Lu et al., 2025）中的定义，单位为厘米/帧 3。 穿透是指物体顶点深入物体内部超过 2 厘米的帧所占的比例，这是 SK-HOI（Peng et al., 2026）中的碰撞度量指标。 表 5 则采用了 HUMOTO 的定义，其中穿透是身体或手对物体最深侵入值的平均数，该平均值基于各帧计算得出。 对于接触准确性（Peng et al., 2026），当身体标记点位于物体表面 2 厘米范围内时，即认为存在接触：T-Acc 是每帧接触状态的准确性，即只要 138 个标记点中任意一个处于接触状态，该帧即被视为接触；B-Acc 则是每个标记点接触状态的准确性。 铰链角度误差是生成的铰链角度与真实铰链角度之间的平均绝对差值，角度范围被限制在 [−π, π] [-\pi,\pi] 内，单位为弧度；而摆动比则是将生成序列中铰链的总运动量除以真实序列中的总运动量。 这些指标 95% 的置信区间均低于 0.02，穿透指标的置信区间则低于 0.2 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: BEHAVE and InterCap enter in their InterAct ( Xu et al., 2025a ) versions, which correct jitter, contacts, and hand poses, and BEHAVE is converted from SMPL+H to SMPL-X. The subject shapes of GRAB and ARCTIC are fitted to the gender-neutral model with SMPLFitter ( Sárándi & Pons-Moll, 2024 ) , so that every source uses neutral shape parameters. All sequences are resampled to 30 fps and expressed in a Y-up frame with the floor at zero and the body centered on the ground plane in the first frame. Every object is a template mesh with a rotation and a translation per frame. The labels that the annotation corrects are the InterAct descriptions of GRAB, BEHAVE, and InterCap, the descriptions of OMOMO, a template sentence for ARCTIC, and the BABEL labels of the walking sequences.
paragraphs.zh: BEHAVE 和 InterCap 采用其 InterAct (Xu et al., 2025a) 版本，这些版本可校正抖动、接触点和手部姿态，而 BEHAVE 则从 SMPL+H 转换为 SMPL-X。 GRAB 和 ARCTIC 的主体形状通过 SMPLFitter (Sárándi & Pons-Moll, 2024) 拟合到中性性别模型中，从而确保每个数据源都使用中性形状参数。 所有序列均重采样为 30 fps，并以 Y 轴向上的坐标系表示，其中地板位于零平面，第一帧中身体中心与地面平面重合。 每个物体都是一个模板网格，每帧包含一次旋转和一次平移。 标注所修正的标签包括 GRAB、BEHAVE 和 InterCap 的 InterAct 描述、OMOMO 的描述（作为 ARCTIC 的模板句子），以及行走序列的 BABEL 标签。

paragraphs.en: Qwen3 receives the rule description, the object name, the given label, and the narrative of the source dataset, and answers in two steps ( Fig. 11 ). It first picks the verb that names the sustained interaction from a fixed inventory of 28 verbs, hold, drink, move, lift, carry, push, pull, drag, switch on, take a picture, play, rotate, kick, dribble, pass, call, eat, see, browse, swing, manipulate, pour, toast, use, shake, clean, set down, interact . It then writes one sentence with that verb, the object, and the acting hand in a fixed form, which the composition later parses. Whether an action requires gaze at the object and involves the head is asked once per verb and object pair in a third query of the same form, and the answer is shared by all clips with that pair.
paragraphs.zh: Qwen3 接收规则描述、对象名称、给定标签以及源数据集的叙述，并分两步作答（图 11）。 它首先从包含 28 个动词的固定列表中，挑选出表示持续交互的动词：hold、drink、move、lift、carry、push、pull、drag、switch on、take a picture、play、rotate、kick、dribble、pass、call、eat、see、browse、swing、manipulate、pour、toast、use、shake、clean、set down、interact。 接着，它以固定格式写出一句话，包含该动词、对象以及执行动作的手，供后续生成环节解析。 对于每个动词与对象的组合，系统会通过第三次相同形式的查询，询问该动作是否需要注视对象以及是否涉及头部；所有包含该组合的视频片段将共享这一答案。

paragraphs.en: The composed pose is the target pose with the joints of the source action replaced: the wrist, elbow, shoulder, and collar of the acting arm, or both arms for a two-handed action. Every manipulation also replaces the two upper spine joints, because the torso bends with a reaching arm, whereas a passive hold replaces the arm alone. An action that requires gaze adds the neck and head, one that involves the head adds the spine as well, and an object the target already holds moves with its wrist when the spine changes. The source objects and worn objects then follow their reference joints through Eq. 1 ( Fig. 14 ). The composition is kept if every object retains the contacts of its rule in at least half of the frames. It is rejected if, in any frame, an object comes within 1 cm of another object or enters the lower body, the hands enter the lower body, or the arms cross. Walking targets, whose arms swing, tolerate such self-intersections in up to a third of the frames.
paragraphs.zh: 组合姿势是目标姿势，其中源动作的关节被替换：执行动作的手臂的手腕、肘部、肩部和衣领，如果是双手动作，则替换双臂。 每次操作还会替换脊柱的上两个关节，因为躯干会随着伸手的手臂而弯曲，而在被动持握时仅替换手臂。 需要注视的动作会额外加入颈部和头部，涉及头部的动作也会加入脊柱，而目标已经持有的物体在脊柱变化时会随其手腕一起移动。 随后，源物体和穿戴物将通过公式 1（图 14）跟随其参考关节运动。 如果每个物体在所有帧中至少有一半时间保持其规则所规定的接触关系，则该组合将被保留。 如果在任何一帧中，某个物体与其他物体之间的距离小于 1 厘米、进入下半身，双手进入下半身，或双臂交叉，则该组合将被拒绝。 对于手臂会摆动的行走目标，最多允许在三分之一的帧中出现此类自相交情况。

paragraphs.en: A sequential composition places a right-hand and a left-hand action one after the other on a target long enough for both, a walking clip, a sitting clip, or one of the two actions itself as a standing body. The second action starts 15 frames before the first ends, the spine and head are interpolated between the two over this overlap, and outside its period each source is frozen at its first or last frame together with its object. Since the two objects are attended to in turn, the gaze check is skipped, and the feasibility checks apply as above (rows two and four of Fig. 14 ).
paragraphs.zh: 顺序组合将右侧动作和左侧动作依次放置在一个足够容纳两者的目标上，例如一个行走片段、一个坐姿片段，或者以站立身体形式呈现这两个动作之一。 第二个动作在第一个动作结束前 15 帧开始，在此期间脊柱和头部会在两者之间进行插值；在此重叠时段之外，每个源对象都会冻结在其第一帧或最后一帧，并连同其对象一同保持静止。 由于两个对象是依次被关注的，因此会跳过注视检查，而可行性检查则如上文所述（图 14 的第二行和第四行）。

paragraphs.en: Five steps enumerate the graph, the first feeding the one-object level: motion, walking clips composed with every compatible source, the one-hand ones serving as further targets; one object, every atomic clip and motion-step composition; two objects, every target with each of its valid sources; three objects, every two-object sequence with the sources valid for both of its rules; and sequential, the ordered pairs above. Worn objects are added at every level. Captions join the clause of each clip with “and” or, for sequential actions, “then”, as in “A person, wearing a backpack, sits on a wooden chair and drinks from a cup with the right hand.” A hand-written bank paraphrases the subject, the sentence frame, the verb, and the hand phrasing, but keeps the object noun phrases verbatim. Training draws one paraphrase per sample, and evaluation uses one fixed paraphrase per sequence ( Fig. 15 ).
paragraphs.zh: 五个步骤对图进行了枚举：第一步是单对象层级，包括动作、由每个兼容源组合而成的行走片段，以及单手动作作为进一步的目标；一个对象时，包含每个原子片段和动作步骤的组合；两个对象时，包含每个目标与其所有有效源的组合；三个对象时，包含每个双对象序列及其两条规则均有效的源；最后是序列层级，即上述有序对。 在每个层级中都会添加磨损的对象。 标题通过将每个片段的从句用“和”连接起来，或者对于连续动作则使用“然后”，例如：“一个人背着背包坐在木椅上，并用右手从杯子里喝水。”手写的银行版本对主语、句子框架、动词和手的描述进行了改写，但保留了宾语名词短语的原样。 训练时每个样本抽取一个改写版本，而评估时则对每个序列使用一个固定的改写版本（图 15）。

sents.en: An articulated object occupies one slot with the pose of its base part and the hinge angle, and its geometry is the assembled mesh at the hinge angle of the first frame.
sents.zh: 一个可活动关节的物体占据一个槽位，包含其基部的姿态和铰链角度；其几何结构为第一帧中对应铰链角度的组装网格。

paragraphs.en: The BPS representation ( Prokudin et al., 2019 ) describes an object by the offsets from 1024 fixed basis points, sampled in a ball around its center of mass, to the nearest points of its surface, for the mesh oriented as in the first frame of the window. Our encoder aggregates these offsets over a fixed partition of the ball into 8 horizontal slabs of 16 cells each, split by azimuth and by distance to the vertical axis. Per-point features from a shared MLP are pooled within every cell and then within every slab, and the slab features are concatenated from bottom to top and projected to the geometry embedding, which preserves the vertical layout of the object.
paragraphs.zh: BPS 表示法（Prokudin 等，2019）通过从 1024 个固定基准点出发，计算到物体表面最近点的偏移量来描述一个物体。这些基准点是在围绕其质心的一定球体内采样的，且网格方向与窗口第一帧中的方向一致。 我们的编码器将这些偏移量在一个固定的球体分区上进行聚合。该球体被划分为 8 个水平层，每个层包含 16 个单元格，并按方位角和到垂直轴的距离进行分割。 来自共享 MLP 的每点特征先在每个单元格内聚合，再在每个层内聚合；随后，各层的特征从底部到顶部进行拼接，并投影到几何嵌入中，从而保留物体的垂直布局。

paragraphs.en: The denoiser consists of eight pre-LN transformer blocks with a model width of 512, eight attention heads, a feed-forward width of 2048, and a dropout of 0.1. Every human frame and every chunk of four object frames is a token, so a window with five objects has 270 motion tokens instead of 720. A one-dimensional convolution of kernel size three decodes the object tokens to per-frame parameters. The temporal order is encoded with rotary position embeddings ( Su et al., 2024 ) : a human frame and an object chunk at the same time receive the same position, whereas the step, sentence, and text tokens receive position zero. A learned type embedding distinguishes human, object, sentence, and text tokens. The denoiser has 27.3M parameters, 25.2M of them in the transformer blocks, the part-assignment head 2.6M, the geometry encoder 0.15M, and the CLIP projection 0.26M, 30.4M in total. The frozen CLIP ViT-B/32 text encoder adds 63.4M parameters, and our re-implementations of MDM and PriorMDM have 20.7M and 39.6M.
paragraphs.zh: 该去噪器由八个预-LN 变换器块组成，模型宽度为 512，具有八个注意力头、2048 的前馈宽度和 0.1 的 dropout。 每一帧人类图像和每一组四帧对象图像均为一个 token，因此包含五个对象的窗口有 270 个运动 token，而非 720 个。 一个核大小为三的一维卷积层将对象 token 解码为每帧参数。 时间顺序通过旋转位置嵌入（Su et al., 2024）进行编码：同一时刻的人类图像和对象块获得相同的位置，而步骤、句子和文本 token 则获得位置零。 一个可学习的类型嵌入用于区分人类、对象、句子和文本 token。 该去噪器共有 2730 万个参数，其中 2520 万个位于变换器块中，部分分配头为 260 万个，几何编码器为 15 万个，CLIP 投影层为 26 万个。 冻结的 CLIP ViT-B/32 文本编码器增加了 6340 万个参数，而我们对 MDM 和 PriorMDM 的重实现分别包含 2070 万个和 3960 万个参数。

paragraphs.en: Per slot, the head receives the object conditioning, the initial pose of the person, and the sentence embedding, then two blocks of self-attention across slots and cross-attention to the text tokens produce one binary output per candidate joint. A joint is labeled as driving an object when it touches the object for at least ten frames and the object travels at least half of the distance that the joint travels meanwhile, and the denoiser receives these labels during training. At decoding, the pose source is selected once per window: the driving joint with the highest average predicted score, a wrist scored by the maximum over its fingers. If no joint is predicted as driving or the highest score is below 0.5, the absolute pose is used. The baselines, which have no part-assignment head, select among all six candidate joints by the same contact scores, so an object follows a joint only while its predicted contact stays high.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个时间片中，头部接收物体条件信息、人物的初始姿态和句子嵌入，随后通过跨时间片的自注意力机制和对文本词元的交叉注意力机制，为每个候选关节生成一个二进制输出。 当一个关节接触物体至少十帧，且在此期间该物体移动的距离至少达到该关节移动距离的一半时，该关节即被标记为驱动物体；去噪器在训练过程中会接收这些标签。 在解码阶段，每个窗口内仅选择一次姿态源：即平均预测得分最高的驱动关节，而手腕的得分则取其各手指中的最大值。 如果没有任何关节被预测为驱动关节，或最高得分低于 0.5，则使用绝对姿态。 基线模型没有用于分配部分的头部，因此它们通过相同的接触分数在所有六个候选关节中进行选择，因此物体仅在预测的接触分数保持较高时才会跟随某个关节。

paragraphs.en: The terms ℒ k \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{k}} of Eq. 5 are ℓ 1 \ell_{1} errors of the human parameters and of their frame-to-frame differences, of the absolute object pose, of the relative poses in their supervised frames, and of the hinge channel, and a cross-stream consistency term. Further terms are squared errors of the object and foot-floor contact scores and a foot-skating penalty on the predicted ankles and toes in frames where the ground-truth foot is in contact with the floor. A forward-kinematics term compares the joint positions of the predicted rotations with the ground-truth positions, and the binary cross-entropy of the part-assignment head completes the objective. The consistency term poses 100 surface points of the object with each of the seven predicted poses, points on a moving part with the predicted hinge angle, and penalizes the ℓ 1 \ell_{1} distance of the points and of their frame-to-frame differences to the ground truth. All weights λ k \lambda_{k} are 1, except 2 for the human-parameter term.
paragraphs.zh: 公式 5 中的项 ℒ k \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{k}} 包括人类参数及其帧间差异的 ℓ 1 \ell_{1} 误差、绝对物体姿态、监督帧中的相对姿态以及铰链通道的误差，还有一个跨流一致性项。 其他项包括物体和脚-地面接触得分的平方误差，以及在真实脚与地面接触的帧中，对预测的脚踝和脚趾施加的脚部滑移惩罚项。 一个正向运动学项将预测旋转的关节位置与真实位置进行比较，而部件分配头的二元交叉熵则构成了目标函数的完整部分。 一致性项将物体表面的 100 个点分别与七个预测姿态进行配准，并将移动部件上的点与预测的铰链角度进行配准，同时惩罚这些点及其帧间差异与真实值之间的 ℓ 1 \ell_{1} 距离。 所有权重 λ k \lambda_{k} 均为 1，但人类参数项的权重为 2。

paragraphs.en: We train for 80k steps with batches of 256 windows using Adam ( Kingma & Ba, 2015 ) with a learning rate of 5 ⋅ 10 − 4 5{\cdot}10^{-4} and a cosine schedule with warm-up, and sample from an exponential moving average of the weights. Training takes eight hours on one RTX 5090. The text prompt is dropped with probability 0.1, replacing the sentence token by a learned null embedding and masking the text tokens. Each worn object is included with probability 0.5, an object name by a null embedding with probability 0.3, and the part-assignment input is removed with probability 0.1.

paragraphs.en: Table 7 reports generation times on one NVIDIA RTX 5090 with the sampler of Section 4 , in fp16 with a compiled denoiser, where the conditional and unconditional passes of classifier-free guidance run as one doubled batch. Single sequences are timed at batch size one as the median of 20 runs after three warm-up runs. The median test sequence has 119 frames and fits one window. The denoising steps dominate without the guidance and its Adam iterations with it. The guidance therefore costs 7.2 times the generation time of a single sequence, but only 1.55 times in the batched evaluation of the test set, since its small kernels underuse the GPU on one sequence.
